source_title: Netflix Hasn’t Offered a Free Option in Six Years, but We Found Two Ways to Get It Without Paying
source_excerpt:

Out of all the streaming platforms available today, Netflix has the largest number of members. It has over 300 million subscribers worldwide, all of them paid users. In 2020, Netflix discontinued its free trial, which had been available for years.
Netflix is home to some of the most talked-about shows and documentaries right now, including The One About Matthew Perry , a three-part series, and Love Is Blind : Boston , which has gone viral on social media more than once.
Without a subscription, you risk missing out on those all-important “watercooler” conversations at work, where everyone seems to be talking about the latest shows you haven’t seen.
In addition to its on-demand library, Netflix also produces and streams live events, such as comedy specials and select WWE matches .
To access this content, users must pay a monthly subscription fee. While it’s not the only streaming service people typically subscribe to, costs can add up quickly across multiple platforms. Netflix’s standard plan with ads is around $8.99 per month, while the ad-free standard plan is about $19.99 per month.
As mentioned, Netflix no longer offers a free trial. While many users hope the guys in suits might bring this back in the future, there is currently no official way to get the service for free directly through Netflix.
However, there are a few alternative ways to access Netflix at no additional cost through certain bundled promotions.
One option is through T-Mobile, which offers a service called “Netflix on Us” with select plans. Eligible customers can get Netflix included at no extra charge. There’s also never been a better time to switch to T-Mobile, as the carrier is currently offering the new iPhone Duo for $1,000 off.
Another option is through Comcast Xfinity. Some of its bundled offerings include packages that feature Netflix alongside other services such as Peacock Premium and Apple TV+ at no additional cost.
You can also access Netflix through DirecTV . While DirecTV does not include Netflix for free, it offers a five-day trial for its own streaming service plans. Netflix can be accessed as an add-on, with billing typically managed through your DirecTV account.
How to Watch The One About Matthew Perry Online for Free
As mentioned above, Netflix just dropped The One About Matthew Perry , a three-part docuseries featuring interviews with family and friends of the late comedic actor, who died in 2023 . The show takes a deeper look at his life, both in and out of the spotlight. Since it’s a Netflix exclusive, the only way to watch is with a Netflix account, which currently requires a paid subscription — unless you take advantage of one of our free-trial hacks.
In addition to The One About Matthew Perry , other titles currently trending on Netflix include Love Is Blind: Boston , Nobody Wants This (now in its third season), Below , East of Eden , and The New Stanford Prison Experiment . Some of these releases have racked up more than seven million views in the past week alone, so if you don’t want to miss out on the conversation, consider signing up for the streaming giant now.
Netflix currently offers a few standard subscription tiers. The ad-supported plan is the most affordable option at around $8.99 per month. The standard ad-free plan is approximately $19.99 per month, while the premium plan is higher-priced at $26.99. Users also have the option to add extra members to their account for an additional fee.
